# Vendored assets

Third-party assets are served from here rather than a CDN, so the app works
offline and makes no third-party requests at runtime. It knows when you sleep;
it shouldn't be phoning anyone.

There is no charting library. Every graphic in the page — the night ribbons, the
clock axis, the guide lines — is SVG built from the data at render time, which
is both smaller than a chart library and the only way to draw a ribbon that is
literally the shape of the night.

## Webfonts, `fonts.css` and `fonts/*.woff2`

Both families are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, which requires
the licence and copyright notice travel with the font files. Full text for each
is alongside them:

| Family         | Licence                        |
| -------------- | ------------------------------ |
| Inter          | `fonts/OFL-Inter.txt`          |
| JetBrains Mono | `fonts/OFL-JetBrains-Mono.txt` |

Only the `latin` and `latin-ext` subsets are included. Note these are variable
fonts: one file covers several weights, so filenames are keyed by family and
subset rather than by weight.

## Refreshing

`fonts.css` was generated by trimming the Google Fonts CSS to those subsets and
rewriting each `src` URL to a local path. If you regenerate it, check that every
`url(fonts/…)` reference resolves to a file that actually exists. Sharing one
file across weights makes that easy to get wrong.
